title: Vogelsdorfer Straße, Neuenhagen
description: Come enjoy a slower pace of life just outside the Berlin borders in the so-called “Speck-Gürtel.” You will love the easy access to green space and the direct connection into Berlin. There is also a direct bus connection that makes commuting to Tesla easy. But most of all we think you'll enjoy calling our peaceful oasis home after a busy day of work or exploring.

title: Vogelsdorfer Straße, Neuenhagen
description: Welcome to your home away from home. Nestled in comfort with a queen bed + two cozy pull-out couches, it sleeps four effortlessly. And in case work beckons, the dedicated home office with standing desk will come in handy. When you're done with work, take time to relax on the spacious patio, watching the evening sky paint itself purple for your viewing pleasure, or alternatively, unwind in our spa-quality bathroom. Overall, though, we're sure you'll love staying in our luxury apartment.

title: Friedenstraße, Neuenhagen

With approx. 150 m2 of living space, the house offers a bright, modern living atmosphere, plenty of natural light, and a spacious feel—ideal for those who want to live comfortably without the effort of moving or furnishing.

Rental Conditions:

• Rental duration: minimum 3 months, maximum 12 months

Suitable for:

• Families in transitional phases (new construction, renovation, relocation)

Features & Highlights:

• 6 bright rooms over 2 floors
• Approx. 150 m2 living space
• 2 modern bathrooms
• Fully equipped kitchen
• Underfloor heating
• New, efficient gas heating system with low consumption

Contact:
If you are interested, have any questions, or would like to arrange a viewing, we look forward to hearing from you.

Move in, settle down, and feel at home—your temporary home away from home.
